Simple Pricing, Deep Infrastructure

We have different pricing models depending on the model used. Some of our language models offer per token pricing. Most other models are billed for inference execution time. With this pricing model, you only pay for what you use. There are no long-term contracts or upfront costs, and you can easily scale up and down as your business needs change.

Service Tiers

Choose how each inference request is scheduled. The standard tier is the default; the priority tier schedules your requests ahead of standard traffic for faster time-to-first-token during peak demand, at a higher per-token price.

TierSchedulingPrice
StandardDefault scheduling, best-effort during peak demand1x base price
PriorityScheduled ahead of standard traffic for faster time-to-first-token1.5x base price
FlexLower cost for non-production and asynchronous work, in exchange for slower responses and occasional unavailability0.8x base price

Enable per request by setting service_tier: "priority". Availability varies by model — check the model page. Read more.

Custom LLMs

You can deploy your own model on our hardware and pay for uptime. You get dedicated SXM-connected GPUs (for multi-GPU setups), automatic scaling to handle load fluctuations and a very competitive price. Read More

  • Dedicated A100, H100, H200, B200 and B300 GPUs for your custom LLM needs

  • Billed in minute granularity

Hardware

All models run on H100 or A100 GPUs, optimized for inference performance and low latency.

Auto Scaling

Our system will automatically scale the model to more hardware based on your needs. By default we limit each account to 200 concurrent requests per public model; dedicated deployments are limited only by their GPUs. If you want more drop us a line

Billing

You have to add a card or pre-pay or you won't be able to use our services. Pre-paid accounts draw down their balance as they go, and invoiced accounts are billed once at the beginning of the following month. You can also set a spending limit to avoid surprises.
